questions.questionsTitle: Q.1. Write the following sets in roster form:

subQuestion.question: ii. Set of even prime numbers from 1 to 50
iv. Seven basic sounds of a sargam (sur)
subQuestion.ans: D = {Sa, Re, Ga, Ma, Pa, Dha, Ni}

questions.questionsTitle: Q.2. Write the following symbolic statements in words:

subQuestion.question: i. 4/3 ∈ Q
subQuestion.ans: 4/3 is an element of set of rational numbers.

subQuestion.question: ii. -2 ∈ N
subQuestion.ans: -2 is not an element of set of natural numbers.

subQuestion.question: iii. P = {P is an odd number}
subQuestion.ans: Set P contains all the odd numbers.

questions.questionsTitle: Q.3. Write any two sets by listing method and by rule method.

subQuestion.question: Set 1: Even numbers less than 10
subQuestion.ans: Listing Method: A = {2,4,6,8}, Rule Method: A = {x | x is an even number and x < 10}

subQuestion.question: Set 2: First five natural numbers
subQuestion.ans: Listing Method: B = {1,2,3,4,5}, Rule Method: B = {x | x ∈ N and x ≤ 5}

questions.questionsTitle: Q.4. Write the following sets using listing method:

subQuestion.question: i. All months in the Indian solar year.
subQuestion.ans: A = {Mesa, Vrsabha, Mithuna, Karkata, Simha, Kanya, Tula, Vrscika, Dhanu, Makara, Kumbha, Mina}

subQuestion.question: ii. Letters in the word ‘COMPLEMENT’.
subQuestion.ans: B = {C, O, M, P, L, E, N, T}

subQuestion.question: iii. Set of human sensory organs.
iv. Set of prime numbers from 1 to 20.
v. Names of continents of the world.
subQuestion.ans: E = {Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, Australia}

questions.questionsTitle: Q.5. Write the following sets using rule method:

subQuestion.question: i. A = {1,4,9,16,25,36,49,64,81,100}
subQuestion.ans: A = {x | x is a perfect square number from 1 to 101}

subQuestion.question: ii. B = {6,12,18,24,30,36,42,48}
subQuestion.ans: B = {y | y is a multiple of 6 and is less than 50}

subQuestion.question: iii. C = {S, M, I, L, E}
subQuestion.ans: C = {z | z is a letter of the word ‘SMILE’}

subQuestion.question: iv. D = {Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday}
subQuestion.ans: D = {p | p is a day of the week}
